messages.posts.noHistory: No unified history exists for this entry yet.

messages.pages.restoreDraftHelp: Restoring loads this copy into the working version while preserving the current publication.

messages.pages.editorial.conflict: Another edit changed the page or site. Reopen before saving.

messages.pages.replaceModelConfirm: Replace the current body with this model? Unsaved body changes will be replaced.

messages.blog.name: Blog
messages.blog.help: Manage articles, publication schedules and your editorial library.
messages.blog.title: Title
messages.blog.author: Author
messages.blog.noindex: Ask search engines not to index this article
messages.blog.heading: Heading
messages.blog.caption: Caption
messages.blog.blockHelp: Use typed blocks. HTML is not executed; code blocks are shown as literal text.
messages.blog.dateHelp: Empty publishes immediately when Published is selected. Future UTC times schedule the article without cron.
messages.blog.previewHelp: Preview shows the saved version and requires an authenticated session.
messages.blog.deletedEntry: Removed entry; saving it restores it.
messages.blog.taxonomyHelp: Authors are editorial bylines, not administrator accounts. Entries referenced by articles cannot be removed.
messages.blog.commentHelp: Only approved comments on published articles appear publicly. Comment collection is off by default. No email addresses are collected.
messages.blog.confirmDelete: Move this item to the trash?
messages.blog.confirmRemove: Remove this entry? Referenced entries cannot be removed.
messages.blog.confirmRestore: Restore this snapshot? The current document will be backed up.
messages.blog.inactive: Enable Blog in the plugin catalog to edit content or restore editorial snapshots.
messages.blog.settingsHelp: These preferences control public reading, feeds and moderated comments. Activation is managed in the plugin catalog.
messages.blog.network: The request failed. Your entered data has been preserved.
messages.blog.error.contract: The blog document contains invalid, incomplete or excessive fields. Check the article, publication date and required references.
messages.blog.error.slug: The slug or identifier is already used. Existing aliases and trashed items also reserve their slugs.
messages.blog.error.storage: Blog storage is unavailable or unsafe.
messages.blog.error.conflict: The document changed in another session. Copy your changes before reloading.
messages.blog.error.inUse: This entry is referenced by an article or child category. Remove those references before deleting it.
messages.blog.error.consent: Consent to publish the supplied name and comment is required.
messages.blog.error.duplicate: This comment has already been submitted.
messages.blog.discussionHelp: Requires discussion enabled in Posts settings. Closing prevents new submissions and preserves approved comments.
messages.blog.templateHelp: The active template supplies the Blog layout. Alternate post formats require declared template support.
messages.posts.optionsHelp: These options control article listings, reading time and moderated discussion. Activation belongs to the plugin catalog.
